svg.title: Two ways into the MCP server built into Bytebase
svg.desc: HTTP clients connect straight to the MCP server in Bytebase. Stdio-only clients go through the Bytebase MCP package, which forwards to the same server. Approval, access control, masking and audit happen in Bytebase, in front of the databases.
svg.text: Two ways into the MCP server built into Bytebase
